_meta.purpose: Template for mapping OLD CLICK curriculum identifiers to NEW CLICK (Click-NewTrial) curriculum identifiers, for a future student-progress migration. The NEW side is fully populated from the live repository/fixture data. The OLD side (old_stage_id, old_chapter_id, old_stage_no, old_chapter_no) is intentionally left null -- it must be filled in by a separate audit of the OLD project/repository, not guessed.
instructions: For each NEW chapter, determine the corresponding OLD chapter_id (if any) by comparing titles and position, not by assuming matching numeric suffixes.

Stage numbering changed: Number Crunching and Patterns were inserted between Loops and Arrays, shifting Arrays/Strings/Searching & Sorting/Functions stage_no by +2 versus whatever numbering the OLD project used for those same stages.
Pointers, Number Crunching, and Patterns are confirmed new stages added after the original curriculum -- do not search for an OLD equivalent; mark no_equivalent unless the OLD audit proves otherwise.
CH0115 (else if) and CH0116 (Capstone Project: Using Arrays) were inserted into pre-existing stages after the fact -- treat them the same way.
Do not invent a mapping. If the OLD project has no evidence of a chapter, leave old_chapter_id null and mapping_type = no_equivalent or needs_verification.
